newsitem.title: KENYA: Buying pressure sustaining Nairobi bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Buying pressure sustaining Nairobi bourse index.

text.p: Heavy buying pressure seen at the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) pushed its 20-share index up 78.71 points to 3628.96 on Monday in a very active trading session, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 20.110 million shillings on 432,972 shares from 19.197 million shillings on 692,017 shares.
"The market opened the week on a very high note with a lot of demand coming in from our local investors," a bourse official said.
"Normally it takes about four weeks to seal a deal with a foreign investor -- I just think a lot of the local investors are cashing in during this period," a senior broker said.
On average prices on most counters edged up marginally propelled by heavy buying in anticipation of good end-year results.
Barclays Bank gained 6.0 to close at 128 while National Industrial Credit closed at 49.25 from 46.75.
Oil concern Total Kenya surged to 94 from 82 while British American Tobacco edged to 81 from 70.50.
There was firm demand for Kenya Commercial Bank at 85 which brokers said had many willing buyers for the long term.

Power monopoly Kenya Power & Lighting traded at 339, up 4.0. Many market players are sceptical about the market's ability to sustain Kenya power at that level-- "At 335 it is simply overvalued and many investors are willing to buy it at a lower price," a bourse official said.

There is a lot of speculation centred on a possible take-over bid of Express Ltd from Lonrho by German clearing and forwarding concern Kuehne & Nagel International and South African firm Viamax Pty Ltd.
Lonrho has a current shareholding of 50 percent of Express Ltd. Both foreign firms are said to be awaiting a go-ahead from Kenya's Capital Markets Authority.
The NSE daily report said there were no deals transacted on the floating bond board which brokers said is a reflection of a wait-and-see attitude adopted by market players.
Kenya Airways closed at 10.50 from 10.35 while Rea Vipingo Plantations eased to 12.30 from 12.35.
